instruction:
Create a function block in Structured Text (ST) that selects a value based on a condition and then performs an aggregation. The function block should have the following characteristics:

Name: FB_ConditionalSelectAndAggregate
Input/Output variables:

VAR_INPUT
Z : INT;  // External input value for comparison and potential selection
VAR_OUTPUT
NEW_Z : INT;  // Result of the selection and aggregation


Internal constants:

A_X : INT := 42;  // Threshold for comparison
A_Y : INT := 333; // Alternative value for selection


Logic:
a. Conditional Selection:

If A_X > Z, select A_Y
Otherwise, select Z
Store the selected value in NEW_Z
b. Aggregation:
Add A_X and A_Y to the selected value in NEW_Z


Implementation notes:

Do not include comments in the function block
Ensure the selection occurs before the aggregation
Use a single assignment for NEW_Z in each branch of the condition
Perform the final aggregation in a separate statement

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_ConditionalSelectAndAggregate
VAR_INPUT
Z : INT;
END_VAR
VAR
A_X : INT := 42;
A_Y : INT := 333;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
NEW_Z : INT;
END_VAR

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Ensure that when A_X (42) is greater than OLD_Z, NEW_Z is equal to A_X plus twice A_Y.

property.pattern_description: If {instance.ax > instance.old_z} is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then {instance.newz = instance.ax + instance.ay * 2} should always be true at the end of the same cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Ensure that when A_X (42) is not greater than OLD_Z, NEW_Z is equal to A_X plus A_Y plus OLD_Z.

property.pattern_description: If {NOT (instance.ax > instance.old_z)} is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then {instance.newz = instance.ax + instance.ay + instance.old_z} should always be true at the end of the same cycle.
